# GitHub Copilot Instructions

Follow `AGENTS.md` and the documentation in `docs/` before suggesting project changes.

The project uses C#, WPF, Clean Architecture, and MVVM. Do not introduce technologies or architecture changes that conflict with `docs/00-project-constitution.md`, `docs/adr/README.md`, or `docs/governance/change-approval-required.md`.

Current sprint target: initialize an empty WPF solution that compiles and runs. Do not implement OCR, translation, screen capture, overlay, cache, hotkeys, or auto-update features before the roadmap reaches those stages.

Never suggest game memory reading, process injection, DLL injection, anti-cheat bypassing, or storing API keys in JSON, SQLite, logs, or app settings.
